news.title: Why Do Middle and High Schoolers Miss School? Selected Findings from the American Youth Panel and the American Parents Panel
news.summary_en: Using data from two surveys administered in late 2025 to nationally representative samples of students and parents, the authors investigate why secondary school-age students are missing school and to what extent these reasons differ by age.

news.title: The RAND School Is Rethinking Higher Ed: Q&A with Nancy Staudt
news.summary_en: Nancy Staudt is leading the RAND School of Public Policy at a moment when higher education is being pushed to evolve in a world defined by constant change.
